questions.text: How long have you carried the weight of everyone else's needs before acknowledging your own?
What happens in your body when you allow yourself to feel the anger you usually keep hidden beneath the peace?
How do you grieve someone who is still sitting right across from you?
What are you afraid would shatter if you finally let your voice be heard?
What is the hardest part about letting yourself sit still with the pain instead of numbing it away?
What does your mind whisper to you when you finally give yourself permission to simply rest?
What could grow in your life if you claimed even a small piece of the day entirely for yourself?
